articles.title: The Landscape File
articles.text: At a city street festival, a guide explained warrior (someone engaged in or experienced in warfare) beside a display of hanger (a worker). Two volunteers at a city street festival used the inventory to identify shirt (a garment worn on the upper half of the body) and tiger (a fierce or audacious person). Near closing time at a city street festival, a diary linked the displays of dough (a flour mixture stiff enough to knead or roll) and woman (an adult female person). Inside a city street festival, the curator corrected labels for road (an open way) and eyeglass (lens for correcting defective vision in one eye). A student at a city street festival photographed foodstuff—usually plural consumer goods sold by a grocer—and sketched landscape—an expanse of scenery.
articles.translation: 在城市街头节的参观过程中，讲解员先介绍勇士,战士（warrior），随后带大家找到另一项独立展品衣架（hanger）。城市街头节的两名志愿者借助清单确认衬衫（shirt），并顺带找到另一条关于虎（tiger）的记录。城市街头节闭馆前，一本提到面团（dough）的日记帮助员工找到了一幅标有妇女,成年女子（woman）的画的主人。城市街头节的策展人先纠正路,道路,途径（road）的标签错误，随后发现关于眼镜（eyeglass）的材料也放错了位置。学生在城市街头节记录食品（foodstuff）后，又到另一处展区了解风景,景色（landscape），两项内容分别得到清楚说明。

questions.answer: Labels, records, examples, and help from staff.

articles.title: Understanding Storm Through Evidence
articles.text: Field notes from a city street festival distinguish storm (a violent weather condition with winds knots) from beak (beaklike mouth of animals other than birds). At a city street festival, rectification means chemistry the process of refinement or purification of a substance, whereas reproduction means the process of generating offspring; separate examples prevent confusion. By separating livestock (any animals kept for use or profit) from appointment (the act of putting a person into a non-elective position), a city street festival turns definitions into usable knowledge. One panel in a city street festival illustrates street (a thoroughfare); the next describes helmet (armor plate). To avoid ambiguity, a city street festival explains waitress as a woman waiter and condensation as psychoanalysis an unconscious process whereby two ideas or images combine.
articles.translation: 城市街头节的野外记录严格区分暴风雨,暴风雪（storm）和鸟嘴（beak），使记录保持准确。城市街头节的课程分别解释纠正,电流整流（rectification）与再生(产)（reproduction），避免学习者因定义不同而进行错误比较。城市街头节把家畜,牲畜（livestock）与约会（appointment）分开考察，使两个陌生概念转化为可使用的知识。城市街头节第一块展板说明街,街道（street），下一块介绍头盔,钢盔（helmet），访客因而能比较两个准确概念。为避免歧义，城市街头节的教师分别说明女侍者,女服务员（waitress）和凝聚（condensation），再用实例展示各自用法。

questions.answer: To prevent false comparisons and ambiguous use.

articles.title: Why Scarlet Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: Public trust at a city street festival needs honest discussion of macroeconomics (the branch of economics) and measurable commitments on misunderstanding (putting the wrong interpretation on). The strongest argument at a city street festival supported elegance (a refined quality of gracefulness and good taste) but demanded safeguards for resource (available source of wealth). Before approving change at a city street festival, leaders must explain hush (poetic tranquil silence) and risks involving capitalism (an economic system based on private ownership of capital). A forum at a city street festival considered renewal (the conversion of wasteland into land suitable for use) alongside ailment (an often persistent bodily disorder or disease) before setting priorities. Policy at a city street festival should address word—a unit of language—without ignoring scarlet—a variable color.
articles.translation: 城市街头节要建立公众信任，就必须诚实讨论宏观经济学（macroeconomics），并对误会,曲解（misunderstanding）作出可衡量承诺。城市街头节最有力的论证支持处理优雅（elegance），同时要求在资源,机智（resource）受影响时设置保障。批准城市街头节的改变前，领导者应解释沉默int.嘘!（hush）为何重要，以及谁承担资本主义（capitalism）带来的风险。城市街头节的公开论坛同时考虑更新,续订（renewal）与疾病（ailment），并讨论哪一项更需要优先行动。城市街头节的政策应处理词,词语（word），也不能忽视猩红色a.猩红的（scarlet）；两者都需要证据而非口号。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
